trial_title: A Efficacy and Safety Study of Adjunctive Perampanel in Primary Generalized Tonic Clonic Seizures
brief_summary: This study is designed to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and pharmacokinetics (PK) of perampanel on Primary Generalized Tonic Clonic (PGTC) seizure frequency in adolescents and adults maintained on one to two stable antiepileptic drugs (AED).

eligibility_table.criterion: Clinical diagnosis of PGTC seizures (with or without other subtypes of primary generalized seizures) and experiencing greater than or equal to 3 PGTC seizures during the 8-week period prior to randomization
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not experienced PGTC seizures, as they first developed seizures at age 13 and have not had any since then for 20 years.

eligibility_table.criterion: Have had a routine electroencephalogram (EEG) prior to or during the Baseline Period with electroencephalographic features consistent with primary generalized epilepsy; other concomitant anomaly should be explained by adequate past medical history
eligibility_table.justification: Full EEG reports are pending, and it is unclear if the EEG will show features consistent with primary generalized epilepsy.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient's routine electroencephalogram (EEG) show electroencephalographic features consistent with primary generalized epilepsy?

eligibility_table.criterion: On a fixed dose of one to a maximum of three concomitant antiepileptic drugs (AEDs) for a minimum of 30 days prior to Baseline; only one inducer AED (i.e., carbamazepine, oxcarbazepine, or phenytoin) out of the maximum of two AEDs will be allowed
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is on multiple AEDs, including Dilantin, which is an inducer AED, but has not been on a fixed dose for 30 days prior to Baseline.

eligibility_table.criterion: A vagal nerve stimulator (VNS) will be allowed, but it must have been implanted greater than or equal to 5 months prior to Baseline (stimulator parameters cannot be changed for 30 days prior to Baseline and for the duration of the study)
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about a vagal nerve stimulator (VNS) being implanted.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient had a vagal nerve stimulator implanted for at least 5 months prior to Baseline?

eligibility_table.criterion: Have had a computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) within the last 10 years (for adults) and 5 years (for adolescents) that ruled out a progressive cause of epilepsy
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has had an MRI within the last 10 years that shows atrophic changes, which does not indicate a progressive cause of epilepsy.

eligibility_table.criterion: A ketogenic diet will be allowed as long as the participant has been on this diet for 5 weeks prior to randomization
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about the patient being on a ketogenic diet.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient been on a ketogenic diet for at least 5 weeks prior to randomization?

eligibility_table.criterion: A history of status epilepticus that required hospitalization within 12 months prior to Baseline
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about a history of status epilepticus requiring hospitalization.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced status epilepticus that required hospitalization at any time within the 12 months prior to the Baseline assessment?

eligibility_table.criterion: Seizure clusters where individual seizures cannot be counted
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not provided information about seizure clusters.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced ≥2 seizure clusters in the past month where individual seizures could not be counted?

eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about a history of psychogenic seizures.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced ≥2 episodes of psychogenic seizures in the past year?

eligibility_table.criterion: Concomitant diagnosis of Partial Onset Seizures (POS)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of focal epilepsy, but there is no mention of a concomitant diagnosis of Partial Onset Seizures (POS).

The patient has a history of severe intellectual disability and anoxic brain injury, which may indicate a progressive neurological condition, but the specific diagnosis of a progressive neurological disease is not confirmed.
The patient does not have a clinical diagnosis of Lennox-Gastaut syndrome, as there is no mention of this specific diagnosis in the profile.

eligibility_table.criterion: If felbamate is used as a concomitant AED, participants must be on felbamate for at least 2 years, with a stable dose for 60 days prior to Baseline. They must not have a history of white blood cell (WBC) count below less than or equal to 2500/microL (2.50 1E+09/L), platelets less than 100,000/microL, liver function tests (LFTs) greater than 3 times the upper limit of normal (ULN), or other indication of hepatic or bone marrow dysfunction while receiving felbamate.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not currently on felbamate, and there is no information regarding WBC count, platelets, or liver function tests related to felbamate use.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient had a white blood cell count greater than 2500/microL and platelets greater than 100,000/microL while receiving felbamate for at least 2 years?

eligibility_table.criterion: Concomitant use of vigabatrin: Participants who took vigabatrin in the past must be discontinued for approximately 5 months prior to Baseline, and must have documentation showing no evidence of a vigabatrin-associated clinically significant abnormality in an automated visual perimetry test
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about past use of vigabatrin or results from an automated visual perimetry test.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient been off vigabatrin for at least 5 months prior to Baseline, and is there documentation of a normal automated visual perimetry test?

eligibility_table.criterion: Concomitant use of barbiturates (except for seizure control indication) within 30 days prior to Baseline
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is currently on phenobarbital, which is a barbiturate, but it is unclear if it is used for seizure control or another indication.

eligibility_table.criterion: Use of intermittent rescue benzodiazepines (i.e., one to two doses over a 24-hour period considered one-time rescue) two or more times within the 30 days prior to Baseline
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is on 20 mg of valium, which is a benzodiazepine, indicating use of intermittent rescue benzodiazepines.

attention_flags: LOW INCLUSION MATCH: only 3 of 16 inclusion criteria met
